user.title: Connect to your Freebox
user.description: Enter your Freebox's local address. Leave the defaults if Home Assistant runs on the same network.

progress.wait_for_button: Press the right arrow button on the front of your Freebox to authorize Home Assistant. This step expires after about 2 minutes.

abort.pairing_denied: Pairing was denied or expired on the Freebox. Please try again and press the arrow button in time.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Freebox. Check the host, port and network connectivity.
